snippet.title: Welcome to Planet E1d0r4d0! | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692950/

Welcome to Planet E1d0r4d0 is a narrative-driven management sim and side-scrolling hunting adventure about a young girl searching for the meaning of existence at the edge of the cosmos. In this chaotic, lawless universe, even immortality feels devastatingly fragile.
